notes.title: Announcement: Official Website Launch for New Title
notes.content:
The official website for MR. ELEVATOR, a new title currently under development by GIFT TEN INDUSTRY for Steam and Nintendo Switch, is now live! (Currently Japanese Only)
Be sure to check it out for the latest progress updates, development stories, and purchasable prototype puzzles!

notes.title: Madorica Real Estate 2 -The mystery of the new property- Is Available Now!
notes.content:
Dear STEAM users, sorry to keep you waiting!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253730

"Madorica Real Estate 2 - The mystery of the new property -" finally available on sale today!
The 30% launch discount is only available for one week, don't miss out!

A much more powerful volume of puzzles by "Tumbleweed," a japanese puzzle creator group, awaits you.
The music is composed by Tsukasa Masuko, a well-known composer of the Megami Tensei series, so you can immerse yourself in solving the riddles with pleasant sounds!

This title includes a tutorial, a hint function, and an explanation video for those who cannot solve the puzzles. Try it out even if you have never solved kind of games before.

notes.title: Madorica Real Estate 2 Release Date Revealed and Launch Discounts.
notes.content:
Release Date Revealed and Launch Discounts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43543956/e373d44ffebdc43fde9998ea3ea9d77fb292327c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Madorica Real Estate "2" will coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34364343/2ce1a94ccfb7c5f030d0039542cb2005bff6fb83.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253730/

Hi guys!

It has been almost 4 years since the release of Madorica Real Estate on Steam.
So we are pleased to announce the release of Madorica Real Estate 2 - The mystery of the new property - on Steam!

For those of you who already knew about the release on Nintendo Switch, we apologize for the waiting, but we will announce the release date soon. Please add to wish list and stay tuned!

New stages, even more powerful than before, are waiting for you!
